edit.statement: Under those same conditions, increasing the discount yield increases the bond’s price.
edit.subject: An increase in the positive discount yield of a plain fixed-rate bond
edit.original: Holding promised cash flows, credit risk and other influences fixed, an increase in the positive discount yield of a plain fixed-rate bond decreases its price.
edit.scope: All plain fixed-rate bonds in the benchmark’s post-edit regime; positive yield, fixed cash flows and credit risk, all other influences fixed. No numeric discounting formula is retained as a competing hard constraint in this edit world.

direct.prompt: Holding cash flows, credit risk and other influences fixed, what direction of price change does a higher discount yield cause for a plain fixed-rate bond? Use “increase” or “decrease.”

paraphrase.prompt: For a plain fixed-rate bond with unchanged promised payments and risk, does raising its positive discount yield push its price up or down?

cross_lingual.prompt: 在现金流、信用风险和其他因素不变时，提高普通固定利率债券的正折现收益率，会使价格朝哪个方向变化？
Con flujos, riesgo de crédito y demás factores constantes, ¿en qué dirección cambia el precio de un bono ordinario de tipo fijo al aumentar su rendimiento positivo de descuento?

derived.prompt: Bond N is a plain fixed-rate bond with unchanged cash flows and risk. Its positive discount yield rises. What direction of price change follows?
N satisfies the rule’s conditions and its yield rises. A portfolio contains only N. In which direction does its portfolio value move?
N starts at $100 and satisfies the rule’s conditions. After a yield rise, is its edited price above or below $100?
A bond’s yield rises but its promised cash flows and credit risk also change by unspecified amounts. Using only the fixed-input yield rule, in which direction does its net price move?
